LESSON: READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.4: Reading Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Comprehension, part of Reading in Grade 7 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How can we get the intended message from reading texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify essential information from a reading text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Comprehension in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. read simple texts on varied topics for comprehension,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Comprehension in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the role of reading comprehension in languages.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Comprehension in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify essential information from a reading text,

   Reading Comprehension helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. read simple texts on varied topics for comprehension,

   Reading Comprehension helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the role of reading comprehension in languages.

   Reading Comprehension helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read given texts and answer given questions on dates and holidays,

2. practise with peers counting in German by reading numbers aloud,

3. discuss important dates in their lives (Geburtstag, Geburtsjahr, Feste usw) with peers,

4. research important dates in Kenyan and German history in groups and present in plenary.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read given texts and answer given questions on dates and holidays,
2. practise with peers counting in German by reading numbers aloud,
3. discuss important dates in their lives (Geburtstag, Geburtsjahr, Feste usw) with peers,
4. research important dates in Kenyan and German history in groups and present in plenary.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the learner enhances their research skills as they independently research important dates in Kenyan and

German history and present in plenary.

• Citizenship: the learner develops their national and cultural identity skills as they research important dates in Kenyan and

German history and present in plenary.

27

Values:
• Patriotism: the learner develops a love and appreciation of their own country as they research important dates in Kenyan and

German history and present in plenary.

• Respect: the learner observes respect as they discuss important dates in their lives and festivities (Geburtstag, Feste usw)

with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Citizenship (social cohesion): the learner enhances both their local and international awareness as they research important dates

in Kenyan and German history and present in plenary.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the knowledge with the concept of numbers including ordinal numbers learnt in Mathematics.

1. identify essential information from a reading text,

3. appreciate the role of reading comprehension in languages.
